title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance 1-4 unit exemption
requirement: The City administers the Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260; properties with one to four units are exempt from rent regulation, and owners meeting an exemption criterion may submit a Rent Control Exemption Request.
coverage_conditions: Properties of 1-4 units are exempt from rent control; the ordinance's other exemptions are available on request.

coverage_quotes: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
The Rent Control Ordinance provides certain exemptions from rent regulation.

exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; the ordinance provides certain exemptions for which an owner may submit a Rent Control Exemption Request.
